answer: An applicant who owns a ridge, owes a mirror and outlasted a harbor is an agent; an applicant holding only the first two is a farm in a hurry. When the panel doubts all else, Spectacle packer steel warrant mounted on the spectacle case still holds, and it holds on each steel is a year of spectacle logs in the optician's ledger. Get caught once and the whole shelf burns: 840 masks, 103320 POA, gone on one grade. The proof is checked where it was made; the applicant's story about the place counts for nothing.
